Holm family: the four ablations within each setting. Misaligned scenario: utility of the design the simulated designer picks (higher is better). Mechanism scenarios: static-penalty constraint (P = 1e3, 1e6) and discrete variables (K = 10, 30), 6 functions x D in {10, 30} each; these scenarios were designed after the benchmark results were known (Section 4.4).

Mean switches in the mechanism scenarios: discrete-10: UPHODS 19.7, noHys 31.7; discrete-30: UPHODS 19.6, noHys 27.0; penalty-1000: UPHODS 20.7, noHys 26.9; penalty-1000000: UPHODS 19.4, noHys 24.8
